name: Uttarakhand Rajya Shilp Ratna Puraskar
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a skilled artisan. 1. The applicant must be at least 45 years of age. 1. The applicant must be proficient in traditional or extraordinary art forms and has made unprecedented contribution in the field of traditional crafts. 1. The artisans must have contributed to the training of young artisans. 1. The applicant must have at least 15 years of experience in a recognized traditional craft. 1. The applicant must not be employed in government/semi-government/cooperative institution/union. **Note:** Preference will be given to artisans who have received national/state-level awards.
